note: City park at the south edge of New England (Hettinger County), beside the rodeo arena south of the Cannonball River: an open camping area of dirt lanes among tree rows, with a ballfield and shelter; used by harvesters in fall, otherwise a quiet town park. No gravel pads. --Claude

The stored note's 'electric hookups' was wrong: hookups none and water/vault toilets written, note rewritten. City site (ndnewengland.com) silent on the park; not on the HHS list. Phone and website flagged; pin ok.
